result: Liu Xiaobo (1955-2017) was a Chinese writer, literary critic, and human rights activist. He was one of the most prominent dissidents in China. In 2009, he was sentenced to 11 years in prison on charges of 'inciting subversion of state power' for his role in organizing the Charter 08 manifesto, which called for political reforms and greater human rights in China. While in prison, he was awarded the 2010 Nobel Peace Prize 'for his long and non-violent struggle for fundamental human rights in China.' He died in 2017 while still in custody, under medical parole, after being diagnosed with liver cancer.
